title: Variance-optimal functions on trees are centered at a vertex
source: Matthew Yancey, “Probabilistic and Geometrical Applications to Graph Theory”, arXiv:1705.09725 (2017). (https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.09725), Conjecture 1.4

lanes.edits_applied: final-paper-revisions-336183-369290-sol62-20261119-r1 (GPT-6.2 Sol; E1-E7 applied, diff reproduces the revised paper)

significance.root_decision: Conjecture 1.4 of Yancey (every variance-optimal function on a tree is centred at a vertex r, with |X(u) - X(r)| = d(u, r) for all u, and r of degree at least 3 when the tree is not a path) is false. On an explicit tree with 34 vertices a feasible function has score 14892, while every vertex-centred function has score at most 14888 (the best centres are vertices 0, 2 and 7), so no variance-optimal function on this tree has a centre. Lean proves that an optimal function exists on the witness and that the first clause fails for every optimum, hence the negation of the whole conjecture. The result contradicts Lemma 19 of Farhadi, Louis, Singh and Tetali (arXiv:2003.05582v3), whose proof treats three sign choices as independent; on the witness the three moves change the variance by -1/289, -72/289 and -1/289 rather than giving the claimed gain of 71/289. Every tree with at most 18 vertices satisfies the conjecture (referee's unpublished computation).
significance.caveat: Bounded literature and registry search only; no erratum or later paper on Lemma 19 of Farhadi-Louis-Singh-Tetali was found. The statement that every tree with at most 18 vertices satisfies the conjecture is an unpublished computation by the referee and is not kernel-checked. No claim that 34 vertices is minimal.

root_basis: Root extracted the six modules from the appendix into an empty directory, rebuilt and kernel-checked them (all exit 0, axioms exactly the allowed three, no forbidden tokens), screened the Principia and mio-qwq archives, the omega registry and GitHub by id. An independent Opus referee checked that the Lean statement is literal and cannot hold vacuously, verified the witness and the bound over all centred functions with its own exact scripts, confirmed the account of the error in Lemma 19 against arXiv v2, v3 and the thesis, and read the paper line by line; its edits were applied.
